description: Consommation d'électricité et de gaz de la communauté d'agglomération d’Arlysère pour la période 2017-2022 - Challenge Data is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d’agglomération Arlysère. These datasets contain records of electricity consumption related to infrastructure, public lighting, water, sanitation and gas of the agglomeration community of Arlysère. Created by a challenge data team, they detail the providers of the different infrastructures managed by the community, the function and geographical location of these sites. Coverage: Communauté d’agglomération Arlysère. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity and gas consumption of the agglomeration community of Arlysère for the period 2017-2022 — Challenge Data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d’agglomération Arlysère. Its keywords include infrastructure, consommation-electrique, consommation-gaz, agglomeration, eau, prix. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2022-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
